notes.title: Clueless Crew 0.4 update is out now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Looters!

The wait is over, the latest [b]Clueless Crew[/b] update is finally here! Over the past two months, we've been hard at work crafting this new content, and we can’t wait for you to dive in.

As always, this update brings plenty of fresh features and improvements, which we’ve neatly compiled into a list, because let’s be honest, who doesn’t love a good list?

[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[b]New Map[/b]: Welcome to MS216 Base, a mysterious zone filled with strange, reddish rock formations. We realized there weren’t enough beginner-friendly (one-star) maps in the game, so this one was designed to fill that gap.

[b]New Monster[/b]: Introducing the Strandmother, a bizarre and unsettling creature with a unique ability. We’ll leave the details for you to discover!

[b]New Tool[/b]: A brand-new gadget has been added to help players track down valuable loot by pointing them in the right direction.

[b]New Character Skins[/b]: At long last, two female character skins have been added, along with a special surprise skin and two hilarious hats to spice up your wardrobe.

[b]Ambient Music[/b]: To make the abandoned buildings feel even more immersive, we’ve added new ambient tracks that will play in the background as you explore.

[b]Truck Driver Voice Lines[/b]: The first-ever truck driver voice lines have made their way into the game! Finding them is easy, just start pressing buttons in the truck and see what happens.

[h2]Fixes & Improvements:[/h2]
[b]Fixed[/b]: A major issue where players were sometimes unable to pick up items.

[b]Adjusted[/b]: Fall damage has been completely removed from the holes on the Liminal Corps map.

[b]Optimized[/b]: Various improvements to map loading and leftover assets to ensure smoother gameplay.

With each update, we squash more bugs and polish the experience, making the game better than ever. Of course, new content means new chaos, but hey, that's part of the fun!

We hope you enjoy the fresh additions, and we can’t wait to see the wild and hilarious moments that come out of them. Thanks to your feedback, we already have a new batch of improvements and features in the works, so a huge thank you to all of our amazing players!

If you have any suggestions or encounter any bugs, be sure to let us know via the in-game "Send Feedback" button. And if you’d like to chat with us or share your best looting moments, [url=https://discord.gg/vsS4zfGUSX][b]join our Discord[/b][/url] server!

Now, go forth and plunder, may your night be long, your loot plentiful, and your workplace accidents minimal!😎

notes.title: Clueless Crew 0.3 Update has arrived!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Crew Mates![/b]

The 0.3 update has arrived, bringing plenty of exciting new content! Explore the narrow, abandoned cells of Ashfeldt Prison, face a deadly new entity, and enjoy various gameplay improvements, including stunnable and pushable enemies, a working radio in the truck, and a reworked loot spawn system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297686/6483826ec5c2e3128a730ef96095f2bb71a3c43c.jpg[/img]

We've also added three brand-new hats and backpacks, available for purchase in the in-game shop — so you can gear up in style before heading into the night! 

And don’t forget to [b][url=discord.gg/vsS4zfGUSX]join us on Discord[/url][/b] for a great chat and [b][url=https://x.com/DeppreSickTeam]follow us on X for more updates![/url][/b]

Enjoy the new update, and we wish you all a safe and successful night filled with plenty of loot!

notes.title: On the Way to Version 0.3!
notes.notes:
Greetings to all crew members!

I hope everyone had a wonderful holiday season and managed to fill your bellies with lots of cookies! After recovering from the sugar and cookie overload ourselves, the work continues on the latest update for the Clueless Crew!

In the new version, we’ve reworked a lot of things, fixed many of the bugs you reported, and are also preparing some exciting new features! Since it’s so satisfying to look at neatly organized lists, I’ve decided that this time we’ll review what’s coming in the next version in this format!

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Duplication issues that allowed players to duplicate tools or loot.
- Multiplayer synchronization issues for players joining mid-game.
- Fixed tick rate-related bugs and improved tool functionality to enhance overall stability.
- Resolved a player revive bug where issues occurred if the ragdoll moved.
- Dropped tools would respawn with fully charged durability after death.
- Many more smaller bug fixes.

At this point, we feel like we’ve addressed almost every game-breaking bug during testing. However, if any new ones pop up, don’t hesitate to let us know via the [b]in-game feedback button[/b] or on our [b]Discord server[/b]!

[b]Improvements:[/b]
- Reworked valuable spawn system: Loot is now distributed across the map based on the quota, with a slight margin. This creates a more stable, automated system, and if we want to introduce new items like gold bars in the future, we simply need to add them to the item pool.
- Navigation mesh improvements for both enemies and players: This ensures that enemies can navigate to all areas, and players won’t experience issues like getting stuck in walls or teleporting to out-of-bound locations.

[b]New Features:[/b]
- The Ashfeldt Prison is a new map featuring unique challenges with its distinctive panopticon prison layout.
- The truck now has a toggleable radio that plays soft music to help stressed and tired crew mates unwind.
- Enemies can now be stunned for a short time using tools that match their backstory. (For example, the ghost of a workplace accident victim is vulnerable to a drill.)
- A new urban legend joins the game: rumored to be a serial killer who died in Ashfeldt Prison. His case file lists the name "Sullivan," and at the time of his arrest, his only possession was a pistol.
- Players can now push back enemies to some extent when they charge at them, reducing the chance of being cornered.
- Jumping from too great a height will now injure players, accompanied by a realistic leg-breaking sound effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297686/265986d8c66562531341bf632c9b58e5867e547a.png[/img]

That was the list of things currently under development that we plan to release in the first days of February. I hope you’re as excited about the upcoming features as we are, and that they’ll help you haul even more loot out of the crumbling, dark buildings!

If you have any questions or would like to share feedback about the game, you can do so using the [b]Send Feedback button[/b] in the game, or reach out to us on our [url=https://discord.gg/vsS4zfGUSX]Discord channel[/url], where we’re available almost anytime! For even more news and updates about our games, make sure to [url=https://x.com/DeppreSickTeam]follow our channel on X[/url]!

notes.title: Clueless Crew 0.2 Winter Update - Military Site Delta and First Aid Station
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297686/e9525f60df0729038eecb1a50f8043990b594751.jpg[/img]

First of all, we want to thank everyone for the incredible amount of feedback and bug reports. You’ve discovered many issues that we’ve fixed in this update, and we’ve also received numerous suggestions on how to make the game even better. Alongside the bug fixes, this update includes a new map, Military Site Delta, and a first aid box has been added to the truck, allowing players to heal themselves for $400. Now, let’s take a look at the full list of changes:

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Military Site Delta – an abandoned military base
[*] First Aid Station in the truck, where players can heal themselves
[*] Screen Resolution and Window Mode options added to the Options Menu
[*] The "Options" submenu is now available within the Escape Menu
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes and Balancing:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players are invincible for a short period of time after exiting a “Hold” door
[*] When a player dies, all their loot now drops to the floor
[*] Enemy “Putrid” behavior changes to make it fairer; becoming alerted is now distance-based
[*] Internally adjusted the behavior of the Drill and Fire Extinguisher for more consistency in multiplayer
[*] Fixed an issue where using the Drill or Fire Extinguisher while changing levels would not stop their usage or clear items
[*] Fixed a problem where certain items were not properly cleaned up after a level change
[*] Resolved an issue where the server could affect the selected Action Slot for clients
[*] Fixed issues with accented characters in one of the fonts
[*] Corrected several areas where doors blocked access or made navigation difficult
[*] Fixed duplication issues with tools and valuable items
[/list]

                                              [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297686/5e3533a8a8c8fe233014c33896d882367e95cc58.jpg[/img]

We’re always happy to hear your ideas and bug reports! You can send them to us using the [b]feedback button[/b] in the game menu, or [url=discord.gg/vsS4zfGUSX][b]join our Discord[/b][/url] server to share any issues you encounter. You can also find us on Discord if you’d like to chat or have any questions about the game!

And finally, we’d like to wish a very Merry Christmas, lots of cookies, happy holidays, and tons of loot to all of You!

[b]Merry Christmas Guys![/b]
[i]Deppresick Team[/i]

notes.title: Clueless Crew 0.1.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello Crew members!

Thanks to the bug reports and feedback received after the release, we’ve already managed to fix some issues and add a few improvements to the game!

0.1.1 Patch

- Gas mask wouldn't be removed if you died.
- Actions that require to hold a button, now show on-screen.
- Disappearing truck elements should now always appear.
- Improved spawn points after entering/exiting buildings.
- The value and description of the loot items is now available in the truck's computer.

Thank you for reporting bugs and providing feedback! Feel free to use the feedback button in the main menu or [b]join our Discord server[/b] to share your suggestions!
